description: Combined counterparty due diligence in one call: an exact OFAC SDN digital-currency-address screen of an EVM wallet AND a UK Companies House KYB lookup (status, type, PSC / beneficial owners), in parallel. Returns both independent results plus an explicit disclaimer that no verified link between the wallet and the company is established by the data. SDN only; a non-match is not clearance. Refused before payment if current sanctions data is unavailable.

company.description: UK Companies House registration number to verify

wallet.description: EVM wallet address (0x + 40 hex) to sanctions-screen

name: diligence
